text: {"lessons":["Frequent reversals can lock in losses: I sold Stock E after buying it in earlier periods, so I should trade from a clear thesis rather than react to short-term moves.","I should manage position sizes and keep the portfolio diversified; adding to stocks while selling others can change my risk quickly.","I should judge decisions by the portfolio’s long-run results and current outlook, not by whether a trade is above or below my average cost."]}
